## Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(betareg)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

```

## Map Layer

```{r}

illinois <- maps::map(
  database = "state",
  regions = "illinois",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  rename(
    state_name = ID
  )

ggplot(
  data = illinois
) +
  geom_sf(
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Information Systems for Illinois",
    caption = "Boundary data: maps R package"
  ) +
  theme_void()

ilco <- maps::map(
  database = "county",
  regions = "illinois",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  rename(
    county_id = ID
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    county_name = str_remove(
      county_id,
      "^illinois,"
    ),
    county_name = str_to_title(
      county_name
    )
  )

ggplot(
  data = ilco
) +
  geom_sf(
    fill = "#F3F4F6",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Information Systems for Illinois",
    caption = "Boundary data: maps R package"
  ) +
  theme_void()

```
## Rurality Layer

```{r}

analysis_data1 <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    Rurality_Category = ntile(Rurality, 3),
    Rurality_Category = factor(
      Rurality_Category,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural")
    )
  )

ilco <- ilco %>%
  select(-any_of("Rurality_Category")) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_data1 %>%
      select(County, Rurality_Category) %>%
      distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("county_name" = "County")
  )

ggplot(data = ilco) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = Rurality_Category),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Urban" = "#C6DBEF",
    "Suburban" = "#6BAED6",
    "Rural" = "#2171B5"
  ),
  na.value = "grey90"
) +
  labs(
    title = "Rurality Across Illinois Counties",
    fill = "Rurality",
    caption = "Boundary data: maps R package"
  ) +
  theme_void()

```
## Layers

```{r}

ilco <- ilco %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "County Population",
    "County Poverty",
    "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS"
  ))) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_data %>%
      select(
        County,
        `Population`,
        `County Poverty`,
        `Number of Hospitals with CHNAS`
      ) %>%
      distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("county_name" = "County")
  )

```

## Priorities

```{r, priorities}

ilco <- ilco %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "Priority_CHNA_1", "Priority_CHNA_2", "Priority_CHNA_3",
    "Priority_CHNA_4", "Priority_CHNA_5",
    "Priority_IPLAN_1", "Priority_IPLAN_2", "Priority_IPLAN_3",
    "Priority_IPLAN_4", "Priority_IPLAN_5"
  ))) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_data %>%
      select(
        County,
        starts_with("CHNA_Priority"),
        starts_with("IPLAN_Priority")
      ) %>%
      distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("county_name" = "County")
  )

```


```{r, graph}
 
# Identify all CHNA and IPLAN priority columns
priority_cols <- grep(
  "^(CHNA|IPLAN)_Priority",
  names(ilco),
  value = TRUE
)

# Function to create each priority map
make_priority_map <- function(priority_col) {

  ggplot(ilco) +
    geom_sf(
      aes(fill = .data[[priority_col]]),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Illinois Counties:",
        str_replace_all(priority_col, "_", " ")
      ),
      fill = "Priority",
      caption = "County boundaries: maps R package"
    ) +
    theme_void()
}

# Display each priority map separately
for (priority_col in priority_cols) {
  print(make_priority_map(priority_col))
}

```

## Combine

```{r}

# 1. Use your existing data
counties <- ilco

# 2. Check columns
print(names(counties))
print(nrow(counties))

# 3. Define indicators
indicators <- c(
  "Population",
  "County Poverty",
  "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS",
  "Rurality_Category",
  paste0("CHNA_Priority ", 1:5),
  paste0("IPLAN_Priority ", 1:5)
)

indicators <- indicators[indicators %in% names(counties)]

if (!length(indicators)) {
  stop("None of the indicator names match ilco. Check names(counties).")
}

if (!"county_name" %in% names(counties)) {
  stop("The county_name column is missing.")
}

# 4. Prepare data for JavaScript
attributes <- st_drop_geometry(counties)

attributes[] <- lapply(attributes, function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "factor")) as.character(x) else x
})

attributes$county_name <- as.character(attributes$county_name)
attributes <- attributes[!duplicated(attributes$county_name), ]

records <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(attributes)), function(i) {
  as.list(attributes[i, , drop = FALSE])
})

names(records) <- attributes$county_name

records_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  records,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  dataframe = "rows",
  null = "null",
  digits = NA
)

fields_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(indicators, auto_unbox = FALSE)

# 5. Create map
map <- leaflet(counties) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
  addPolygons(
    layerId = ~county_name,
    group = "Counties",
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    weight = 0.7,
    fillColor = "#9ECAE1",
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~county_name
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = -91.6, lat1 = 36.9,
    lng2 = -87.4, lat2 = 42.6
  )

# 6. Add dropdown, map coloring, and dynamic legend
js <- sprintf(
"
function(el, x) {
  var map = this;
  var records = %s;
  var fields = %s;

  var colors = [
    '#ffffcc', '#c2e699', '#78c679',
    '#31a354', '#006837'
  ];

  var categoricalColors = [
    '#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#E15759',
    '#76B7B2', '#59A14F', '#B07AA1',
    '#9C755F', '#EDC948', '#FF9DA7'
  ];

  function getValue(name, field) {
    return records[name] ? records[name][field] : null;
  }

  function numericValues(field) {
    return Object.keys(records)
      .map(function(name) {
        var v = getValue(name, field);
        return v !== null && v !== '' &&
          typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : null;
      })
      .filter(function(v) { return v !== null; })
      .sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
  }

  function isNumericField(field) {
    return numericValues(field).length > 0 &&
      Object.keys(records).some(function(name) {
        var v = getValue(name, field);
        return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
      });
  }

  function categoryList(field) {
    return Array.from(new Set(
      Object.keys(records).map(function(name) {
        var v = getValue(name, field);
        return v === null || v === undefined || v === ''
          ? 'Missing' : String(v);
      })
    )).sort();
  }

  function colorFor(value, values) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return '#d9d9d9';
    }

    if (isNumericField(selectedField) &&
        typeof value === 'number' && values.length) {
      var rank = values.filter(function(v) {
        return v <= value;
      }).length / values.length;

      return colors[Math.min(4, Math.floor(rank * 5))];
    }

    var categories = categoryList(selectedField);
    var index = categories.indexOf(String(value));

    return categoricalColors[
      (index < 0 ? 0 : index) %% categoricalColors.length
    ];
  }

  var selectedField = fields[0];

  // Dropdown control
  var control = L.control({position: 'topright'});

  control.onAdd = function() {
    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
    div.style.background = 'white';
    div.style.padding = '10px';
    div.style.minWidth = '220px';

    var label = document.createElement('label');
    label.textContent = 'County Health Indicator';
    label.style.display = 'block';
    label.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
    label.style.marginBottom = '6px';

    var select = document.createElement('select');
    select.style.width = '220px';
    select.style.padding = '5px';

    fields.forEach(function(field) {
      var option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = field;
      option.textContent = field;
      select.appendChild(option);
    });

    select.addEventListener('change', function() {
      selectedField = this.value;
      updateMap();
    });

    div.appendChild(label);
    div.appendChild(select);
    L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);

    return div;
  };

  control.addTo(map);

  // Dynamic legend
  var legend = L.control({position: 'bottomright'});

  legend.onAdd = function() {
    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'info legend');
    div.style.background = 'white';
    div.style.padding = '10px';
    div.style.borderRadius = '5px';
    div.style.boxShadow = '0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    div.style.lineHeight = '20px';
    div.style.maxWidth = '240px';
    div.style.maxHeight = '250px';
    div.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    return div;
  };

  legend.addTo(map);

  function updateLegend(values) {
    var div = legend.getContainer();
    var html = '<b>' + selectedField + '</b><br>';

    html += '<i style=\"background:#d9d9d9;width:12px;height:12px;display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;\"></i> Missing<br>';

    if (isNumericField(selectedField) && values.length) {
      var min = values[0];
      var max = values[values.length - 1];

      for (var i = 0; i < colors.length; i++) {
        var lower = min + (max - min) * i / 5;
        var upper = min + (max - min) * (i + 1) / 5;

        html += '<i style=\"background:' + colors[i] +
          ';width:12px;height:12px;display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;\"></i> ' +
          lower.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1}) +
          '–' +
          upper.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1}) +
          '<br>';
      }
    } else {
      var categories = categoryList(selectedField);

      categories.forEach(function(category, i) {
        if (category === 'Missing') return;

        var color = categoricalColors[
          i %% categoricalColors.length
        ];

        html += '<i style=\"background:' + color +
          ';width:12px;height:12px;display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;\"></i> ' +
          category + '<br>';
      });
    }

    div.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Update polygon colors, popups, and legend
  function updateMap() {
    var values = numericValues(selectedField);

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
      if (!layer.options || layer.options.layerId == null) return;

      var name = String(layer.options.layerId);
      if (!records[name]) return;

      var value = getValue(name, selectedField);

      layer.setStyle({
        fillColor: colorFor(value, values),
        fillOpacity: 0.85,
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        weight: 0.7
      });

      var content = '<b>' + name + '</b>';

      fields.forEach(function(field) {
        var v = getValue(name, field);
        content += '<br><b>' + field + ':</b> ' +
          (v === null || v === undefined ? 'Not available' : v);
      });

      layer.bindPopup(content);
      layer.bindTooltip(
        '<b>' + name + '</b><br>' + selectedField + ': ' +
        (value === null || value === undefined ? 'Not available' : value)
      );
    });

    updateLegend(values);
  }

  updateMap();
}
",
  records_json,
  fields_json
)

map <- htmlwidgets::onRender(map, js)

# 7. Save the map
output_path <- path.expand(
  "~/Desktop/DataVisualization/Illinois_County_Health_Leaflet.html"
)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  map,
  file = output_path,
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

cat("Map saved to:", output_path, "\n")
cat("Indicators included:", paste(indicators, collapse = ", "), "\n")

```
